name: com.zloysvin.unity-lines
description: Code-driven world-space lines, polylines, Bezier curves, arcs and circles for URP. Includes adaptive curve detail, retained paths and reusable mesh batches. No LineRenderer required.

samples.description: A self-contained demo prefab with its own camera. Shows retained curves and a frame-only animated line. Drag into an empty URP scene and press Play.
